messages.content: Analyze this sentence.  "Consydre thou myne condicyon; reflecte upon myne fader. Shall I forsake hym, when he is strycken wyth blyndnesse and destytute, to wrastle wyth infirmitie and penurye, when it lyeth wythin my poure to rendre hys latter yeeres fylled wyth comforte and joye?" Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.

message.content:
Consydre the archaic spelling and syntax that define this sentence.
reflecte upon the historical context of the language used here.
Shall I forsake the moral obligation implied by the speaker?
when he is strycken wyth blyndnesse, the condition described is severe.
and destytute, to wrastle wyth infirmitie and penurye, the struggle is evident.
when it lyeth wythin my poure to rendre hys latter yeeres fylled wyth comforte and joye?
